name: Scroll Reading Text
description: A scroll-driven text effect for React: a big paragraph fills word by word, left to right, from grey to colour as each line crosses the reading line, with inline icons that fill the same way. Words near the cursor step aside and settle back. No dependencies.

props.name: text
props.description: The paragraph. Write {name} where an inline icon from `icons` should sit.

props.name: icons
props.description: Inline icons by name: an SVG path for a 24×24 viewBox, drawn as a stroke in the text colours.

props.name: dimColor
props.description: Colour of text not read yet.

props.name: readLine
props.description: Where on the screen a line fills, from 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

props.name: avoid
props.description: Words near the mouse step aside.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the paragraph (font, size, line height).
